mapper.select:
select ID as id,`NAME` as name,DEPT as dept,DEPT_ID as deptId,ID_NUMBER as idNumber,'1' as userType,'' as insUnit,MAJOR as eduMajor, GREATEST(IFNULL(FIRST_GRADUATE_DATE,''),IFNULL(SECOND_GRADUATE_DATE,''),IFNULL(THIRD_GRADUATE_DATE,'')) as graduateDate from PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and `STATUS` = '0'
and `NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')
union all select a.ID as id,a.`NAME` as name,a.DEPT as dept,a.DEPT_ID as deptId,a.ID_NUMBER as idNumber,'2' as userType,a.INS_UNIT as insUnit,a.MAJOR as eduMajor,b.GRADUATE_DATE as graduateDate from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL a left join (select FILE_ID,max(GRADUATE_DATE) as GRADUATE_DATE from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL_DEGREE where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY FILE_ID ) b on a.ID = b.FILE_ID where a.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and a.HR_STATUS='0' and a.`STATUS` in ('0','1')
and a.`NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')

select a.*,IF(d1.ID is not null,d1.DICT_LABEL,a.CERT_TYPE) as certTypeDict, IF(d2.ID is not null,d2.DICT_LABEL,a.LEVEL) as levelDict from (select cert.*, IF(b.ID is not null or c.ID is not null,1,cert.CERT_STATUS ) as userStatus, CASE WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近一个月' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from HR_CERT_MANAGE cert left join PERSONNEL b on cert.USER_TYPE='总部' and cert.USER_ID = b.ID and b.STATUS = '1' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' left join HR_SUB_PERSONNEL c on cert.USER_TYPE='分公司' and cert.USER_ID = c.ID and c.HR_STATUS = '1' and c.`STATUS` in ('0','1') and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a left join DEV_DICT d1 on a.CERT_TYPE_ID = d1.ID and d1.CATEGORY='BIZ' left join DEV_DICT d2 on a.LEVEL_ID = d2.ID and d2.CATEGORY='BIZ' ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.* from (select cert.*, IF(b.ID is not null or c.ID is not null,1,cert.CERT_STATUS ) as userStatus, CASE WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近一个月' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from HR_CERT_MANAGE cert left join PERSONNEL b on cert.USER_TYPE='总部' and cert.USER_ID = b.ID and b.STATUS = '1' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' left join HR_SUB_PERSONNEL c on cert.USER_TYPE='分公司' and cert.USER_ID = c.ID and c.HR_STATUS = '1' and c.`STATUS` in ('0','1') and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*,IF(d1.ID is not null,d1.DICT_LABEL,a.CERT_TYPE) as certTypeDict, IF(d2.ID is not null,d2.DICT_LABEL,a.LEVEL) as levelDict from (select cert.*, IF(b.ID is not null or c.ID is not null,1,cert.CERT_STATUS ) as userStatus, CASE WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY < DATE(NOW()) then '已过期' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近一个月' WHEN cert.VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND cert.VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from HR_CERT_MANAGE cert left join PERSONNEL b on cert.USER_TYPE='总部' and cert.USER_ID = b.ID and b.STATUS = '1' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' left join HR_SUB_PERSONNEL c on cert.USER_TYPE='分公司' and cert.USER_ID = c.ID and c.HR_STATUS = '1' and c.`STATUS` in ('0','1') and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE') a left join DEV_DICT d1 on a.CERT_TYPE_ID = d1.ID and d1.CATEGORY='BIZ' left join DEV_DICT d2 on a.LEVEL_ID = d2.ID and d2.CATEGORY='BIZ' ${ew.customSqlSegment}
